Shell(python3 -c " import re, sys try: import yaml except ImportError: sys.exit('NO_YAML') for f in ['_posts/2026-08-18-when-agents-hunt-in-packs.md']: text = open(f).read() m = re.match(r'^---
(.*?)
---
', text, re.S) assert m, 'front matter not found' print(f, '->', yaml.safe_load(m.group(1))) ")

Shell(ruby -ryaml -e " %w[_posts/2026-08-18-when-agents-hunt-in-packs.md _posts/2026-08-18-welcome-to-project-lighthouse.md].each do |f| m = File.read(f).match(/\A---
(.*?)
---
/m) abort("#{f}: front matter missing") unless m p [f, YAML.safe_load(m[1], permitted_classes: [Date])] end ")

Shell(cat > "$COMMANDCODE_SCRATCHPAD/check_fm.rb" <<'EOF' require 'yaml' Dir['_posts/*.md'].each do |f| m = File.read(f).match(/\A---
(.*?)
---
/m) abort("#{f}: front matter missing") unless m fm = YAML.safe_load(m[1], permitted_classes: [Date]) abort("#{f}: missing keys") unless %w[layout title date category summary].all? { |k| fm.key?(k) } puts "#{f}: OK — #{fm['title']} (#{fm['date']}, #{fm['category']})" end EOF ruby "$COMMANDCODE_SCRATCHPAD/check_fm.rb")
